stop_status: CLEAR. B27-X2 is repaired in src/store/store_lib.rs:1670-1699: OSSL_STORE_attach's fetched branch assigns loader_ctx only after loader_set_params accepts, so a refused params set closes the provider context once, releases the fetched loader once, leaves loader_ctx NULL, and returns NULL without publishing a store. No store with loader = NULL can be built through the attach path any more. The refusal probe passes in the normal court and under ASan and fails on the temporarily restored pre-fix ordering; the child-process canary observes the pre-fix shape faulting at both OSSL_STORE_close (:655) and OSSL_STORE_load through OSSL_STORE_eof (:1491). No new hidden obligation; the pre-existing B27-R1 allocation-refusal leak is unchanged and remains recorded.

authority.abi: No export, signature, #[repr(C)] layout, allocator size/file/line, unsafe lint attribute or detector changed. The repair only reorders one local assignment in OSSL_STORE_attach's fetched branch; the refusal now returns NULL instead of publishing the authority's UB state.
external_contracts: OSSL_STORE_LOADER_fetch returns one reference the caller owns; OSSL_STORE_LOADER_free releases exactly one caller-owned reference.
A provider p_attach returns a context the caller owns; p_close releases it exactly once.
A provider p_set_ctx_params may legitimately answer 0; loader_set_params then answers 0 (a defined refusal, not an ABI violation).
OSSL_STORE_close accepts NULL and answers 1; OSSL_STORE_load requires a live OSSL_STORE_CTX and is not defined on NULL.
The core-BIO wrapper takes and releases its own BIO reference; the file loader's context takes a second and file_close releases it.
A published OSSL_STORE_CTX with fetched_loader == NULL must have a live loader, because close/load otherwise dereference (*ctx).loader.

boundaries.mechanism: OSSL_STORE_attach fetched-branch ownership of the provider loader context and the fetched loader when loader_set_params refuses
boundaries.disposition: SAFETY_DISCHARGED (scope: the refused loader_set_params path in OSSL_STORE_attach; B26-X1 and the rest of the file's M1 boundaries are unchanged)
boundaries.contract: Pre-fix: loader_ctx = attached ran before loader_set_params. On refusal p_close(attached) released the context, OSSL_STORE_LOADER_free released the fetch reference and fetched_loader became NULL, but the local loader_ctx stayed non-NULL, so the guard did not fire and the store was published with loader = NULL and a closed loader_ctx. Post-fix: loader_ctx is assigned only in the accepted-params arm. On refusal loader_ctx stays NULL, the end-of-function guard returns NULL, and no store exists; the context and loader have each been released exactly once.
defects: Pre-fix src/store/store_lib.rs:1672-1697 assigned loader_ctx before loader_set_params; the refusal branch left it non-NULL and the function published loader = NULL, fetched_loader = NULL, loader_ctx = closed pointer. OSSL_STORE_close reached (*(*ctx).loader).closefn at :655 and OSSL_STORE_load reached OSSL_STORE_eof's (*(*ctx).loader).eof at :1491, both NULL dereferences.
residuals: B27-R1 is unchanged: a refused OwnedCtx::<OsslStoreCtx>::zalloc or ossl_pw_set_ui_method after a successful attach still returns NULL without releasing fetched_loader/loader_ctx. The authority has the same leak; it is not UB and is recorded, not hidden.
